essence: Alone supreme nectar-one ablaze, all-swallowed: venerated.
Melted bliss-mass; principle likened in form venerated.
Script-outlines man; shape reveals varied You.
Light-goddess-flowers arranged; guru unfolded, heart entered.
Reflecting praise in body-temple, bonds outpoured.
Five-named conquer; splits gained, mouths called.

sections.SUMMARY: Oṃ to Consciousness-Bhairava; shelter-takers take knowing, wander never vain; grace-bent Śiva conquers. Bhairava alone supreme nectar-one ablaze; sense-ring-swallowed all; venerated. Praised-praiser-praise though distinct undiffering; whatever formed by knowing becomes this, enduring. All melted, bliss-massed; Your principle's likeness in Your shape venerated. Letter-script outlines man; shape reveals varied-formed You, supreme self. Concept-free entered; we reflect what fancy never catches. Made, worded, offered: guru unfolded then heart entered. Mirroring praise of own-massed self; bonds outpoured in body-temple. Named powers conquer; splits gained, mouths skull-called. Objected limbs Yours to Sadāśiva; corpse-self Your seat.

rasa.dominant: maṅgala-bhakti of salute; bhakti-vīra of praised alone; adbhuta of undiffering three; bhakti-adbhuta of likeness venerated; adbhuta of revealed shape; vīra of concept-free reflecting; bhakti of arranged offerings; bhakti-vīra of temple praise; vīra of conquering powers; adbhuta of corpse-seat
rasa.sthayibhava: praṇaya at shelter-commanded; bhaktyutsāha at nectar-one; vismaya at praised-praiser-praise one; bhakti-vismaya at melted likeness; vismaya at script-revealed You; utsāha at never-caught truth; bhakti at flower-laid entering; bhaktyutsāha at bonds-outpoured; utsāha at named conquerors; vismaya at corpse-self seat
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is love-address: salute, shelter, conquer. Invoking relished. The sthāyibhāva is devotion-exultation: alone, nectar, ablaze, venerated. Praising relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: three named, none apart. Undifference relished. The sthāyibhāva is devotion-wonder: melted, massed, likened, venerated. Likeness relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: outlined, massed, revealed. Revealing relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: entered concept-free, reflected true. Reflecting relished. The sthāyibhāva is devotion: made, worded, laid, entered. Offering relished. The sthāyibhāva is devotion-exultation: praised mirroring, bonds poured, temple named. Praising relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: named, conquering, called. Conquering relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: limbed, Sadāśiva'd, corpse-seated. Seating relished.
